title: Core Validation 009B-1 — Carrier Causal Sufficiency
decision_question: Using the same causal step size, does the train-fitted common carrier component of a real frozen-Pythia write preserve most full-write target improvement without materially increasing unrelated harm, while the non-carrier residual contributes little target gain?

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 006/007/009A pinned sequence selection; router examples may participate in projection preparation/extraction batching but never in 009B-1 train/eval statistics

geometry.write: G_i = mean_t[(U^T dL/dh_t) z_t^T] on the frozen foundation path
geometry.carrier: r = normalized mean of train-token projected activations z; fitted independently per seed using train only
geometry.same_step_rule: full, carrier and residual always use the same eta for a target; carrier/residual are never renormalized after projection

discovery.ratio_definition: rho = ||delta_h_full||_F / ||h||_F on the target sequence; eta is solved independently per target from the full normalized direction
discovery.selection_rule: Select the largest rho that independently on both discovery seeds has full-write descent fraction >=0.95, median full normalized NLL gain >=1e-5, median half-step linearity error <=0.25 and p90 half-step linearity error <=0.50.

confirmation.peer_selection: deterministic SHA ordering; one unrelated peer per other source where available

primary: actual target mean-NLL gain under full/carrier/residual interventions
unrelated positive NLL harm and carrier excess harm normalized by full target gain
diagnostic: carrier energy fraction of each write
metrics.whole_model_causal_nll: required; geometry-only local-action residual is not a scientific gate

replication.formal_hardware: Kaggle GPU; foundation is used only to extract frozen hidden/gradient signatures, after which causal interventions use frozen hidden states and lm_head

stop_rule.discovery_failure: Do not open confirmation; the causal intervention scale could not be made both measurable and locally stable.
stop_rule.confirmation_failure: Stop the shared-carrier persistent-effect route. Do not run effect compression/addressability experiments without a new residual-aware hypothesis.
stop_rule.confirmation_success: Proceed to Core 009B-2 Persistent Effect Geometry. Do not add routing, certificates or growth yet.

interpretation_boundary: A positive result supports causal sufficiency of the common-carrier component for this frozen-Pythia regime; it does not establish reusable effect coordinates, deployable addressability, safe continual mutation, bounded growth or an end-to-end CLM.
A negative result does not invalidate Core 009A geometry; it shows that the geometry is not causally sufficient under the frozen intervention protocol.
Carrier and residual use the exact same eta as the full direction. Renormalizing projected components is forbidden because it would erase the causal magnitude question.
All carrier statistics are fitted on train tokens only. Eval targets and peers never influence r.
